physical.title: Near-base probe inside a circular glass cap

interpretation.requestedResult: Record the cap boundary and detector observations for an inside probe near the table.
stated: A27 shows a 30 mm high cap of a sphere with radius 50 mm, glass index 1.6 and an observer 80 mm above the table on axis.
assumptions: Unit-index exterior. An on-axis native source is placed 0.0625 mm inside the base, with a chosen 1.8° cone and relative brightness 0.04. The real detector is placed at the stated axial distance with an assumed finite length. Partial reflection is disabled.
unknowns: Table surface optics and original illumination.
